headline: Juggle more than one thing, and answer ALIBI right from your notifications.

highlights.title: Run tasks side by side
highlights.body: Start as many tasks as you like on Today. Each keeps its own time, and your day counts overlapping time once.

highlights.title: Pause or finish from the shade
highlights.body: Every running task sits in your notifications with Pause and Done. When its planned time is up, ALIBI asks: done, or 15 more minutes?

highlights.title: Start right on time
highlights.body: Up next reminders now have Start now and Snooze, and check-ins wait until your day starts.

highlights.title: Know where your hours went
highlights.body: Insights shows your productive time, biggest tasks, and planned versus actual for any day, week or month.

notes: Run tasks side by side: several tasks can run at once
Pause or finish from the shade: Pause, Done and +15 min buttons
Start right on time: Start now and Snooze on Up next
Know where your hours went: time insights for any period
